🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX showing a CORRECTION (1W: -1.24% | 1M: +20.22%) and SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.43% | 1M: -4.18%) while HYG (1W: +0.03% | 1M: -1.24%) and LQD (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -2.31%) are in RECOVERY — mixed signals support the NEUTRAL read.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear neutral/volatile: VXX CORRECTION (1W: -1.24% | 1M: +20.22%) ↓ falling short-term but elevated month-to-date. Credit neutral: HYG (1W: +0.03% | 1M: -1.24%) RECOVERY and LQD (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -2.31%) RECOVERY show limited relief in spreads.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral overall: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -3.08%) pointing to modest duration weakness while dollar and curve metrics are flat in the barometer.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.34% | 1M: +10.65%) ↑ rising and sector breadth shows Energy, Materials and Financials positive; XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -2.42%) showing tech weakness. Style: Value/cyclicals showing relative strength vs Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US tepid: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.43% | 1M: -4.18%) while Europe RECOVERY via FEZ (1W: +0.20% | 1M: -9.77%) and China weak: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -0.55% | 1M: -6.18%). EM (EEM BELOW TREND 1W: -0.24% | 1M: -8.30%) remains soft.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed: IWM RECOVERY (1W: +2.36% | 1M: -4.20%) shows small-cap short-term bounce, IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -0.22% | 1M: +9.96%) signals crypto strength over the month, while ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -3.01%) shows thematic caution.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Divergent: CPER RECOVERY (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -6.91%) while GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -12.29%) and SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -17.54%) show metal sell-off; broad commodity rallies (BNO/USO/UGA) display 1W vs 1M corrections.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy firm: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.34% | 1M: +10.65%) ↑ rising; natural gas volatile: UNG CORRECTION (1W: -6.39% | 1M: +3.49%) and BNO CORRECTION (1W: -6.50% | 1M: +43.82%) highlight short-term retracement after big monthly gains.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.34% | 1M: +10.65%) and sector breadth (Energy, Materials, Financials positive) align. DIVERGENCE: Multiple commodity and volatility ETFs show 1W vs 1M mismatches (BNO, USO, VXX, IBIT) — minor divergence relative to core equity indices.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals and energy exposure given XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.34% | 1M: +10.65%); reduce exposure to gold GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -12.29%) and defensive staples/utilities which are lagging.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +4.34% | 1M: +10.65%) ABOVE TREND if momentum holds. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -2.42%) BELOW TREND if tech weakness broadens.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Select oil exposure (BNO 1W: -6.50% | 1M: +43.82% CORRECTION) for mean-reversion scenarios. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -12.29%) BELOW TREND on metal outflows.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 watch — VXX CORRECTION (1W: -1.24% | 1M: +20.22%); HYG/LQD parity — HYG (1W: +0.03% | 1M: -1.24%) RECOVERY, LQD (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -2.31%) RECOVERY; XLK/XLF pivot — XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -2.42%), XLF RECOVERY (1W: +2.44% | 1M: -3.53%).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed breadth: Breadth 5/11 sectors positive, indicators flat-to-mixed supporting a neutral regime. Energy and cyclicals showing relative strength — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.34% | 1M: +10.65%), XLK tech weakness persists (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -2.42%) BELOW TREND. Key risk is the cross-market divergence in commodities and volatility (BNO 1W: -6.50% | 1M: +43.82% CORRECTION; VXX 1W: -1.24% | 1M: +20.22% CORRECTION) — monitor for spillover.
